indices.name: LMArena (arena.ai) Text Arena score
indices.note: Bradley-Terry Elo from human pairwise votes, style control default. Variants: claude-fable-5.1-max, muse-spark-1.3-max, gemini-3.8-flash-high (preliminary), gemini-3.1-pro-preview, kimi-k3-max, glm-5.3-max, qwen3.8-max (original snapshot; 0902 not listed), gpt-6-astra-max (2693 votes, CI +-12), deepseek-v4-pro-high-20260813, gpt-5.6-luna-xhigh, gemma-4-31b, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001. Grok 4.7 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash not listed.

indices.name: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3
indices.note: Composite of AA's own evaluations; best-scoring reasoning-effort variant per model (e.g. Fable 5.1 Max Effort, GPT-6 Astra max, Grok 4.7 xhigh, Qwen3.8 Max (0902), DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Max Effort, DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 Max Effort, GPT-5.6 Luna max, Claude 4.5 Haiku Reasoning). Gemma 4 31B (Reasoning) is marked by AA as estimated.

indices.name: Epoch AI Capabilities Index (ECI)
indices.note: Item-response-theory aggregate over many public benchmarks (page https://epoch.ai/benchmarks/eci); one score per model, no effort variants. Grok 4.7 not listed yet; DeepSeek V4.1 Flash has a wide interval (148.5-157.5).

indices.name: LiveBench global average (release 2026-06-25)
indices.note: Contamination-limited benchmark; global average = mean of the 7 category means (reasoning, coding, agentic coding, math, data analysis, language, IF) computed from the published table (page https://livebench.ai/). Best variant listed: claude-fable-5-1-max-effort, gpt-6-astra-max, muse-spark-1.3-xhigh, grok-4.7-xhigh, gemini-3.8-flash-high, gemini-3.1-pro-preview-high, gpt-5.6-luna-max, deepseek-v4.1-flash-max; qwen3.8-max snapshot unspecified. Gemma 4 31B and Claude Haiku 4.5 are not in this release.

method: For each of the four indices, the score of the variant closest to the OpenRouter model (the best-scoring reasoning-effort variant when several are listed) was taken for the 14 tournament models, then min-max normalised to 0-1 across the models of this set that the index covers (1 = best of this set on that index, 0 = worst). The composite is the plain mean of the normalised values over the indices where the model appears; indices_count says how many that is (4 at most). Normalising within this set means a model absent from an index that holds the set's bottom or top (Gemma 4 31B and Claude Haiku 4.5 are missing from LiveBench, Grok 4.7 from LMArena and ECI, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash from LMArena) is compared against a slightly different range there, so composites of models with fewer indices, and close gaps in general, are less certain. Usage rankings such as OpenRouter's are not used.
